done 3fea55c9, report /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/async/a15-join-within-child.md.report.md

- **What works:** `join(within:, on_timeout:)` now works on a `task::ChildHandle` the same way it does on a `TaskHandle`. By default, a time-out throws `task::TimedOut`, the task keeps running and the handle can be joined again. With `task::OnTimeout::Cancel` the task is cancelled and the handle is used up.
- **What changed:**
  - Two checker predicates now accept `ChildHandle` as well as `TaskHandle`.
  - `std.contracts` has entries for the two new `ChildHandle` calls.
  - The emitter needed no change.
- **Rust I added** (all in `group.rs`):
  - a new `ChildHandle::join_within`. It takes `&self`, so the generated code doesn't need `let mut h`. Its error is a `Box<dyn Error>`, because a plain group's error type (`Crashed`) can't hold `TimedOut`.
  - a new `cancel_here` helper, which `cancel` now uses.
  - two fields changed type: `claimed` is now a `Cell` and `held` a `RefCell`.
- **`NK2109`:** not asked of a child handle. Part I 8.2 says a child handle left live is waited for when its group ends.
- **Tests:** three new tests, `async_join_within_child_{keeps_the_task,cancel_stops_the_task,in_time}`. The compiler before the change refused the shapes of the first two with NK1103; I didn't run `in_time` on it. All `async_`, `task_`, `spawn_` and `overlap_` tests pass at both settings (65 passed, 0 failed). The std `task::` unit tests pass (7/7), clippy is clean, `lower-std` is stable on a second run, and pre-push is green.
- **Found (needs your decision), a defect from a14 outside my change:** 8.2 says a pausing `async(handle)` task whose handle is dropped while still live is waited for when its group ends. Instead it is cancelled at its pause. This includes a handle left live after a default time-out that the handler doesn't take. The task's remaining part is held in the handle and may borrow values that end before the group does, so dropping the handle can only cancel it. The report has a one-line probe. Because of this, I added no test for the left-live case.
- **Not mine:** the brief's `else => throw error` example still fails in `rustc`; that is #1242.
- **Disk:** test cache 2.7 GB, 4.4 GB free on `/`, no new cache entries over 100 MB.
